verified.note: AEAT publishes the composition here: for a Spanish national “ocho dígitos (teniendo en cuenta que los primeros pueden ser ceros) más una letra de control”, and for the K and L forms “una letra inicial… siete caracteres alfanuméricos… un carácter de verificación alfabético”. That is the nine-character shape this record's format encodes. The page publishes the composition; it does not publish the letter's arithmetic.

note.en: Three rules under one nine-character shape, which is why they are one engine here and one field on the card. A DNI is eight digits and a letter taken off a mod-23 table; an NIE is that same rule once the leading X, Y or Z has been read back as the 0, 1 or 2 it stands for; a CIF is an entity-type letter, seven digits, and a control computed Luhn-wise over them. THE CIF CONTROL IS THREE CASES AND ONLY TWO OF THEM CAN BE NAMED. For K, P, Q, R, S, N and W the register always issues it as a letter, and for A, B, E and H always as a digit, so those are checked against the one they must be and a failure can report the character it expected. Every other entity type takes either, and which one it got was the register's decision rather than the arithmetic's — so a mismatch there is reported without naming an expected character. Naming one would send half of those holders to a NIF that is not theirs, and "wrong" is honest where "should be 1" is not. There is no denied list, and the absence is the point: the all-zero form of each of the three shapes — 00000000T, X0000000T, A00000000 — satisfies its own arithmetic, and all three are already refused by the shared zero-serial rule in js/engines.js, which reads the serial the engine says was allocated rather than the number as typed. Listing them again per record would be a second copy of a general rule, and the second copy is the one that drifts.
Electronic address for e-invoice routing: the EAS scheme code plus your identifier. Carry it now and the card is already correct when a counterparty moves to Peppol.
note.es: Dirección electrónica para el enrutamiento de facturas: el código de esquema EAS más tu identificador. Tenerlo ya deja la tarjeta lista cuando una contraparte pase a Peppol.

note.en: B2G e-invoicing is long mandatory. The B2B obligation is legislated but commences on pending regulation — check the current date before relying on it.
note.es: La facturación electrónica B2G es obligatoria desde hace años. La obligación B2B está legislada pero su entrada en vigor depende del reglamento pendiente: confirma la fecha vigente antes de darla por hecha.
